La vidéo semble filmée sous la pluie : g: Makes the video look filmed in the rain: water drops on the lens or a window (adjustable amount), the darker picture of a rainy day, falling rain, mist, storm lightning.
Comme filmé sous la pluie : gouttes d'ea: As if filmed in the rain: water drops on the lens or a window, darker and colder picture, falling rain, mist, lightning. Sliders at 50%: normal setting for the chosen weather. Adjust, then right-click the clip → “Apply rain” to animate the drops.
Calcule les gouttes animées avec les rég: Computes the animated drops with the current Rain settings (until then, the preview shows still drops).
